Name: 360 Mega App Pack HD
Overview: 360 Mega App Pack HD features a number of fun and useful applications. In Rumble Lounge you can choose from one of our relaxing preset massages or try a custom massage session. Other applications include Ultra Clock, Omega Calculator, and more. Also included are Super Button Mashing Bros (an 8-bit button mashing classic), Arrow Panic (a multiplayer action strategy game), and Memory Masters.
